settings.text: Three measurements are all you need to choose bedding that fits well.

settings.heading: Measure the width
settings.text: Measure across the top of the mattress from one side to the other.

settings.heading: Measure the length
settings.text: Measure from the head of the mattress to the foot.

settings.heading: Measure the depth
settings.text: Measure from the bottom seam to the top, including any topper you use.

settings.heading: Tip
settings.text: Measure the mattress itself, not the bed frame, and round up to the nearest inch.

settings.question: How much bigger than my mattress should a flat sheet be?
settings.answer: A flat sheet needs to cover the top of the mattress, run down each side and tuck underneath. As a rough guide, add twice the mattress depth plus about 15 cm (6 in) on each side for tucking in, to both the width and the length.

settings.question: Which duvet filling size should I choose?
settings.answer: Compare the filling sizes with your bed and your duvet cover. For a full, fluffy look, choose a filling close to the size of your duvet cover.
